defects: Quantity shortfall: 100 EACH invoiced, only 60 EACH received (GR-7706, balance of 40 on backorder)
rationale: Goods PO with a valid receipt showing only 60 of 100 EACH delivered (40 on backorder). Under clause 4 the quantity dispute resolves in favour of the receipt: pay 60 x $9.50 = $570.00 net. Unit price matches the PO exactly (clause 3), and tax recomputed at the vendor's 7.5% on the corrected net is $42.75, giving $612.75 gross; the supplier's $71.25 tax is simply the consequence of the over-invoiced quantity, not a separate defect. Single defect, so no clause 11 escalation; $612.75 falls in the AP_CLERK band (clause 10).
